items.title: Symlink node in the macOS fallback-PATH fixture so dynamically linked Node (Homebrew Cellar) resolves
acceptance: local-skills-process.test.ts 'resolves a user-installed npx outside the macOS GUI launch PATH' passes on a machine whose node binary needs its sibling lib directory
the fixture no longer copies the node binary; behavior on CI/Linux Node (self-contained binary) is unchanged
npm test is green for apps/desktop/src/main/adapters/local-skills-process.test.ts
items.notes: Baseline failure observed 2026-09-28: copyFile(process.execPath) breaks Homebrew Cellar node (@rpath libnode.dylib lookup fails outside Cellar).

items.title: Widen process-lifecycle observation budgets in timing-sensitive tests that flake under parallel load
acceptance: ssh-transport-runner.test.ts retained-stream scenarios no longer race a 2s wall-clock budget against real spawn+terminate chains
remote-bootstrap postflight tests and the TargetsView registry test carry explicit timeouts sized for loaded CI machines
npm test passes twice in a row on this workstation without flaky timeouts
items.notes: Baseline failures observed 2026-09-28 under coverage load: boundedRunnerResult 2000ms race lost; 5000ms default testTimeout exceeded by remote-bootstrap postflight cases.

items.title: Exercise the packaged darwin arm64 app through the repo's CDP proof lane in a disposable fixture
acceptance: npm run package:darwin produces apps/desktop/out/Skills Desktop-darwin-arm64/Skills Desktop.app
prove-inventory drives the packaged workspace against the stub-npx fixture and asserts the pinned skills@1.5.23 list argv
prove-about asserts the unsigned-preview About surface (Manual upgrade, version, diagnostics export)
fixture is disposable; evidence lands under .scratch/verify-skills-desktop/evidence and is not committed
items.notes: Extends the Linux-only packaged lanes to this darwin-arm64 operator machine; no product change intended.

items.title: Backfill coverage for the weakest-covered production module after the factory's first full coverage run
acceptance: one module below or nearest the 80 percent coverage threshold gains behavior-focused tests
the new tests fail without the production behavior they lock in (checked by mutation spot-check or coverage delta)
npm run test:coverage stays above all thresholds
items.notes: Pick the target from the coverage report produced during iteration; prefer boundary modules with real branch gaps.

items.title: Route every publication and studio preload bridge capability through its fixed IPC channel
acceptance: preload/workspace.test.ts asserts channel, attachment-epoch, and forwarded arguments for package.import, publication choose-source/export/prepare/review/discard/reconcile, and studio open/release/validate/draft-create/draft-save/draft-delete/preview/export
a regression in any routed channel name or argument order fails the test
npm run test:coverage stays above all thresholds
items.notes: Coverage run showed preload/workspace.ts at 78.57% statements; uncovered 143-222 are the package/publication/studio bridge methods added for Publish and Studio views.

items.title: Cover publication and studio main-process IPC handlers including authorized forwarding and bounded failures
acceptance: electron-ipc.test.ts exercises the publicationHandler family: package:import, publication choose-source/export/prepare/review/discard/reconcile, studio open/release/validate/draft-create/draft-save/draft-delete/preview/export
each handler is asserted to reject unauthorized senders, forward the closed request type with version 2 to the session, and return the bounded internal_error on session failure
npm run test:coverage stays above all thresholds
items.notes: Coverage run showed electron-ipc.ts at 71.23% statements; uncovered handler bodies cluster in lines 720-833 (publicationHandler family) and studio channels.

items.title: Cover the uncovered StudioView user paths surfaced by the coverage report
acceptance: StudioView.test.tsx gains tests for the uncovered user-visible paths identified by the coverage report
tests assert rendered behavior rather than implementation internals
npm run test:coverage stays above all thresholds
items.notes: StudioView.tsx reported 74.6% statements; uncovered blocks cluster around lines 509-513 and 603-634 per the coverage table.

items.title: Cover OpenSSH host-trust confirm lifecycle, resolution validation, and tool runner bounds
acceptance: openssh-target.test.ts covers confirm() success, expiry, target drift, mid-review key change, and pendingChallenge projection
resolve failures are covered: nonzero -G exit, incomplete effective config, unsafe hostkeyalias, port-22 identity, scan failure classification
quoteOpenSshConfigValue escaping/rejection and memory trust store replace/lookup are covered
npm run test:coverage stays above all thresholds
items.notes: openssh-target.ts reported 67.83% statements / 52.77% branches after SDF-007; SSH stays experimental scope, but the trust and resolution paths are pure interfaces behind injected runners and stores.

items.title: Bind verified state to source freshness, gate plan, and complete required-gate coverage
acceptance: deliver rejects tracked-file edits made after a passing verify even when HEAD is unchanged
deliver rejects untracked non-ignored files that appear after a passing verify
deliver rejects gate-plan edits (argv, timeouts, or item gate list) made after a passing verify
verify --gates <subset> records complete:false with the missing required gates and lands in failed instead of verified
regression tests cover failure, retry, recovery, honest partial diagnostics, and in-repo tracked backlog state churn
items.notes: Root probes reproduced three false-success paths (boundary-20260928T190712.598065Z); follow-up probe confirmed the fix at 19:58Z. Backlog file is excluded from sourceDigest but bound via planDigest + itemDigest.
